# Synthetic migration fixtures

Sources and hashes are pinned in source-inventory.json. import_fixtures.py generates v1–v4 SQL/FTS shapes, duplicates/states/order/times/native blobs, malformed types, nil settings/hotkey conflicts,17MiB owned archive, WAL and hot-journal cases. import_native_test.cpp generates Unicode/RTF/HTML and repeated file URLs/root filename offers and exercises actual clipboard/delete paths. import_macos.py generates old NSKeyed shortcut/exclusion/folder archives, modern JSON settings and declared image dimension failures. legacy.swift --fixture/--image-fixture generates actual Realm schema7 files and Cocoa archives. All data is synthetic, tiny image headers or repeated test bytes. Binary DBs are generated at test time to keep the repo small. Historical personal backups remain a manual gate.
